name: Coins
summary: Stacks of gold coins with loose coins in front; anim drop lands a coin on the stack.

params.name: y
params.note: floor point under the stacks (1 m ~ 560 px)

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 the group is about 500 px wide; use about 0.5 next to a person

params.name: anim
params.note: drop = a coin falls onto the left stack and fades on landing, every 60 frames

author: krakujs
